_comment: Every pages/api route must invoke an approved authentication primitive OR appear here.
An entry is a reviewed CLAIM, and the gate re-verifies its mechanical evidence on every run:
machine-secret → names env var(s) the file must reference; the fail-open shape is rejected separately (R4)
webhook-signature / machine-token → the named verifier must be invoked
retired → must answer 410 and must not write; redirect-shim → must redirect and must not touch the database
public/health → may not write unless the entry declares "writes"
identity-scoped → must still authenticate; exempts only R2 (ids are scoped to the caller's own user)
Adding an entry requires security review. There is no grandfathered baseline.

_methodExemptionsComment: STEP 3AH-91 (F1, R1-METHOD): per-HTTP-method exemptions for routes that authenticate on other methods.
Each is a reviewed CLAIM re-verified on every run: public → the branch never writes; stub → the branch has no await, no DB call and no call into an imported module.
Each entry names the open finding it tracks; when the route is fixed the gate prints a WARN asking for the entry's removal. Adding an entry requires security review.
_knownOpenComment: STEP 3AH-91 (W2F-1/W2F-3): CONFIRMED open findings, owned by another workstream, surfaced by the strengthened gate (routes that RE-EXPORT their default handler; secret checks that are open outside production).

A known-open entry does NOT hide the finding: the gate prints every tracked violation as KNOWN OPEN on every run. Only R2/R3 (tenant/campaign binding) and R4-ENV (closed in production, open elsewhere) can be tracked - never R1, R1-METHOD or R4. When the rule stops firing the gate prints a WARN asking for removal.
Remove the entry in the same change that fixes the route. Adding an entry requires security review.

pages/api/auth/resend-invitation.ts.reason: Self-serve branch (body.email, no authentication, rate-limited, constant response) revokes the pending invitation (update revoked_at), creates a fresh invitation and enqueues the invitation email. OWNER REVIEW DONE (WSF-ORD remediation): PUBLIC BY PRODUCT CONTRACT, not a defect - the branch is the documented recovery for a lost/expired invite link, so it cannot require the token it exists to replace; it is 5/hr per IP + 3/hr per email limited, answers a constant 200, and takes company + role from the EXISTING invitation row, never from the request, so it can only re-issue an invitation a tenant admin already created, to the same address. auth/resend-verification.ts is declared allow:auth-flow for the identical shape. DELIBERATELY NOT declared auth-flow here: that kind is order-exempt for the WHOLE route and would also exempt the authenticated admin branch (resolvePrincipal + requireTenantAccess role gate) from R1/R2.
